content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

Alex, if your lower back hurts after deadlifts, don't push through it. Sharp pain, pain that lingers for days, or pain with numbness or tingling in your legs means you stop and see a doctor or physio. I can't diagnose it. ⚠️

If it's only mild soreness, drop the weight by 20–30% and film your form. Check that your back stays neutral and the bar stays close to you. Keep everything pain-free, and swap in something easier on the back for now, like Romanian deadlifts or hip thrusts.

Do you want me to pull up your recent deadlift history so we can see how the load has been progressing?
